1.1.40 — Ask looks things up

  • Ask searches the web. Questions the page can't answer — service times, opening hours, addresses, prices — are looked up on the web and the site's other pages, with sources you can open.
  • No more dead ends. If the page doesn't say, Pane searches instead of stopping there, and follow-ups keep track of what you were asking about.
  • Cleaner answers. No more stray "untrusted" markers or asterisks in replies.

1.1.39 — A lighter Ask

  • Ask no longer slows your Mac. The glow and animations while Pane answers now take a fraction of the work, so the rest of your Mac stays quick while it writes.
  • Answers start sooner. The on-device model starts loading the moment you open the panel.
  • Smoother text. Answers flow in without the stutter on long replies.

1.1.38 — Ask with ⌘E

  • ⌘E opens Ask. The panel for asking about the page you're reading now opens and closes with ⌘E (it was ⌘J).
  • A smoother Ask panel. The panel now slides over the page instead of squeezing it on every frame, so it opens and closes without stutter.
